newsitem.title: USA: Polyphase to soon file 1996 annual report.
newsitem.headline: Polyphase to soon file 1996 annual report.

text.p: Polyphase Corp said Tuesday it plans to file its 1996 annual report within a week.
A company spokesman said the trading halt that has hovered over the company since Febraury is expected to be lifted as soon as the report is filed.
A dispute over a technical non-monetary default with a subordinate lender held up the company's ability to report fourth quarter and year-end results, spokesman Charles Moskowitz said.
"The conflict caused us not to be able to file our annual report on a timely basis," he said.
